readerCopy.body: The responsibility holding everything together can also be the responsibility making change impossible. When Saturn squares the North Node, duty and forward movement create friction, allowing a job, contract, caregiving role, debt, deadline, or obligation to occupy enough time and authority that a needed choice keeps being deferred. The responsibility can be valid while the arrangement built around it is unsustainable. The pressure becomes useful when the actual cost is visible enough to show what needs renegotiation, completion, delegation, or an ending.
